cli.intro: OpenPPT — create, inspect and play editable presentation decks on one native model.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.create: Create a native deck and save it to a project file
cmd.open: Open a project file and print its committed revision and slides
cmd.inspect: Run geometry and rule checks on a project file
cmd.play: Walk the static show of a project file

opt.title: Deck title
opt.slide: Add a slide with this title (repeatable)
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.checks: Comma-separated checks: overflow, contrast, alignment, assets, fonts, out-of-bounds
